name: Cairo and Hurghada Tour
description: Achieve your dream while experience Cairo and Hurghada Tour Package with Red Sea Holidays, explore Hurghada Desert, Red Sea water activates, in addition, head out towards Cairo the twinkling city where you can explore Pyramids of Giza, walkthrough Egyptian Museum and more with Holidays to Red Sea.
overview: Achieve your dream while experience Cairo and Hurghada Tour Package with Red Sea Holidays, explore Hurghada Desert, Red Sea water activates, in addition, head out towards Cairo the twinkling city where you can explore Pyramids of Giza, walkthrough Egyptian Museum and more with Holidays to Red Sea.

itinerary.title: Arrive Hurghada(Group tour)
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Hurghada Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Hurghada. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Giftun Island Tour (Group Tour)
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, Then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada port, catch your cruise for a fascinating trip to Giftun Island the magnificent national park, your cruise will drop you to isolated beach, Take a leisurely snorkeling and swimming, at the end of your tour drive back to your hotel in Hurghada. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Sindbad Submarine Tour (Group Tour)
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, then around 09:00 am. Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to enjoy unforgettable Sindbad Submarine, it is guided tour below the Red Sea level around 25 Meters, scout the underwater magic with its landscapes and dazzling coral reefs, at the end of your tour transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour (Private Tour)
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada Airport, Catch your flight to Cairo, arrive Cairo domestic airport, start to Embrace Cairo culture by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, your last stop will be at Khan El-Khalili market, at the end of your tour transfer to Cairo domestic airport, Fly back to Hurghada, meet & assist at Hurghada Airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Hurghada, optional excursion to tuck into spectacular islands like Mahmya and Tiran Island, plenty of water activities are waiting for you, swimming, diving or snorkeling are available, or Enjoy optional at night to ALF LIELA W LIELA SHOW. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada Airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet at Hurghada Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned vehicle
Accommodation for 05 Nights in Hurghada including breakfast and all taxes
One day Group tour to visit Giftun Island including Equipments
Day trip to Sindbad Submarine (Group Tour)
Group tour to Hurgada with English speaking escort
One day tour in Cairo as mentioned at the above itinerary.
All transfers in Hurghada by private air conditioned vehicle
Entrance fees to the above mentioned sites at the itinerary
Transfer to Hurghada Airport for final departure
exclusions: Supplement cost for the Grand Egyptian Museum instead of the Old Egyptian Museum: USD 25 per person
Entrance inside any of the pyramids will be with extra fees (Tickets can be booked on the Spot) -1st Great Pyramids: 35.00 USD$ - 2nd Pyramids OR 3rd Pyramid: 15.00 USD$
Optional tours not mentioned at the above itinerary
